items.title: Physical properties of alkenes (printed as a second 11.6.2)

source_refs.note: Physical Properties of alkenes, printed as a second 11.6.2 on page 256.

items: The first three members, ethene, propene and butene, are gases at room temperature; C5 to C15 are liquids and the higher members solids.
They are insoluble in water but soluble in alcohol.
They have a characteristic smell and burn with a luminous flame.
Unlike alkanes they show weakly polar properties, because of sp2 hybridisation.
